meta.source: Our World in Data, CO2 and Greenhouse Gas Emissions dataset
meta.base: Global Carbon Project and Jones et al., via OWID
meta.coverage: China: every column of OWID's CO2 and greenhouse-gas dataset with a value, 1850 to 2024, annual. 76 series.
meta.note: Values as published by OWID (licence CC BY 4.0). Producers per column are named in OWID's codebook: Population based on various sources (2024); Bolt and van Zanden – Maddison Project Database 2023; Global Carbon Budget (2025); Global Carbon Budget (2025); Population based on various sources (2024); Global Carbon Budget (2025); Bolt and van Zanden – Maddison Project Database 2023; Global Carbon Budget (2025); U.S. Energy Information Administration - International Energy Data (2026); Energy Institute - Statistical Review of World Energy (2025). Growth rates, per-capita figures, shares and cumulative sums are OWID's own arithmetic on those inputs.
